newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian casino income soars in 95/96 - ABS.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian casino income soars in 95/96 - ABS.

text.p: Gambling takings at Australia's 14 casinos jumped 36 percent to A$1.88 billion in the year to June 30, 1996 from A$1.38 billion in 1994/95, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) said on Tuesday.

The casino industry generated an operating profit before tax of A$198.0 million, which equates to an operating profit margin of 8.9 percent, compared with an operating profit of A$107.4 million in 1994/95 and a margin of 6.5 percent, the ABS said.
Gross income, including catering revenue, for all casinos rose to A$2.23 billion from A$1.65 billion, with the nation's four biggest casinos operators taking 80 percent of the total.
